name: Mortimer

quests: Fallen From Grace (partial completion for Wyrmscraig Cavern access)

notes: Offers two tasks, increasing to three choices after completing 50 Mortimer tasks.
Assigns tasks with superior variants. Venators are assigned directly only by Mortimer.
Slayer points are awarded only with the point modifier; the default task gives no points.
Task modifiers can change quantity, points, clue rates, superior rewards, and Slayer experience.
Skipping costs 100 points and there are only two block slots. Turael cannot replace Mortimer tasks.
Mortimer maintains a separate task streak. Combat requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape at 99 Slayer.
